charge_port.notes: Wikipedia: J1772 inlet for AC, with the SAE Combo (CCS1) DC inlet a factory option on 2017-2020 cars (standard from 2021 Premier and 2022). Cars without the option have only J1772 and no DC.

supercharger_access.notes: Estimated: GM announced the NACS adapter for all GM EVs on 2024-09-18, US first and Canada before the end of 2024 (Auto123, ArenaEV); no Canadian page for this exact model was readable (gm.ca, chevrolet.ca, cadillaccanada.ca return 403). Assumed the Canadian car has the same adapter access as the US car. Markets on this powertrain: CA and US; US reads InsideEVs' list.

wheels.notes: LT: 17 in; Premier not shown (17 in in 2017 and 2021).
